text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
CapitalOf(x, y) ::: x is the capital of y.
MostPopulous(x) ::: x is the most populous.
Host(x, y) ::: x hosted y.
HasHosted(x, y) ::: x has hosted y.
RanksAmong(x, y) ::: x ranks among y.
Universities(x) ::: x are universities.
ConsistentlyRanked(x) ::: x are consistently ranked.
AsiaPacific(x) ::: x is in Asia-Pacific.
World(x) ::: x is in the world.
x = Beijing ::: Beijing

Premises:
LocatedIn(Beijing, NorthernChina) ::: Beijing is located in Northern China.
CapitalOf(Beijing, People'sRepublicOfChina) ::: Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China.
MostPopulous(Beijing) ::: Beijing is the world's most populous national capital city.
Host(Beijing, SummerOlympics2008) ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Olympics.
Host(Beijing, SummerParalympics2008) ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Paralympics Games.
HasHosted(Beijing, SummerOlympics) ∧ HasHosted(Beijing, WinterOlympics) ::: Beijing has hosted both the Summer and Winter Olympics.
HasHosted(Beijing, SummerParalympics) ∧ HasHosted(Beijing, WinterParalympics) ::: Beijing has hosted both the Summer and Winter Paralympics.
∑x (Universities(x) ∧ ConsistentlyRanked(x) ∧ RanksAmong(x, AsiaPacific)) ::: Many of Beijing's universities consistently rank among the best in the Asia-Pacific.
∑x (Universities(x) ∧ ConsistentlyRanked(x) ∧ RanksAmong(x, World)) ::: Many of Beijing's universities consistently rank among the best in the world.
